raw_segments.text: I feel so astonished, she began. I hardly know what to say to you, Miss Eyre. I have
surely not been dreaming, have I? Sometimes I half fall asleep when I am sitting alone
in fancy things that have never happened. It has seemed to me more than once when I
have been in a doze, that my dear husband, who died fifteen years since, has come in
and sat down beside me, and that I have even heard him call me by my name, Alice, as he
Now, can you tell me whether it is actually true that Mr. Rochester has asked you to
marry him? Don't laugh at me. But I really thought he came in here five minutes ago and
said that in a month you would be his wife.
